experiment: PX4 FMUv6C v1.17.0 KLAF cacheless guest-only diagnostic
primary: QEMU process CPU seconds between FMI initialization at zero and the first solver step at or above 45 simulated seconds, maximum overshoot 2 ms
secondary: Full FastDyn process lifetime wall seconds including initialization, mission and shutdown, excluding adapter validation
oracle: Both firmware and FMI waypoint tracks, estimator, actuator/attitude telemetry, landing and disarm
estimator: Median original/firmbolt ratio over complete pairs, two-sided percentile bootstrap 95% interval at the complete-pair level, 20000 draws, seed 2601
failure_policy: Run each scheduled mission once. Preserve every failure. Report complete-pair interval only if all 12 pairs and both warmups pass.
scope: Guest-only cacheless diagnostic on the qualification mission previously used to profile the recipe. No tuning, selection or independent final-performance claim.
